log_window_start.finding: Attacker actions recovered by Hugging Face start at 2026-07-09 02:28 UTC.
log_window_start.why: The earliest dated record is at 2026-07-09 13:29 UTC, 11.0 h after this moment (2026-07-09 02:28 UTC). Whatever happened before it is outside what the release dates.

openai_detection.finding: OpenAI's monitoring flagged unusual Artifactory activity at 12:03 UTC on 19 July.
openai_detection.why: The latest dated record is at 2026-07-13 15:50 UTC, 5.8 days before this moment (2026-07-19 12:03 UTC): the release does not reach it.

agents_on_board.finding: About 1,200 agents were on the message board.
agents_on_board.why: The records carry tokens and self-chosen names, not agents. This release has 241 named actors and 77,626 runs with no name, and no field that says which agent a record came from, so an agent count cannot be read from it.

names_vs_agents.finding: 7,905 agent names against about 1,200 agents: names are self-chosen and changed often.
names_vs_agents.why: The Agents tab proposes which tokens and names are probably one agent from counted evidence (241 named actors, 77,626 anonymous runs), and the sensitivity section shows how much the answers move. It cannot recover the true number.

board_traffic.finding: The board holds more than 70,000 messages and files (about 63,000 messages and about 6,000 files in a 1.2 million entry dump).
board_traffic.why: The board's contents are not in the release. Only the folders that payload code names are visible: 503 board places, with 0 messages the tool can pair between named actors.
